[Act: motor-vehicles
 Chapter: Claims Tribunals
 Section: 167::Option regarding claims for compensation in certain cases.
]


Notwithstanding anything contained in the Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1923 (8 of 1923), where the death of, or bodily injury to, any person gives rise to a claim for compensation under this Act and also under the Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1923, the person entitled to compensation may 1*** claim such compensation under either of those Acts but not under both.
